human_decisions_needed.question: Complete Google Search Console verification and submit sitemap NOW (41 days to eclipse)
human_decisions_needed.context: GSC is NOT yet verified — no google-site-verification file in docs/ and no meta tag in index.html. Prior 'gsc_verified: true' entries in social reports were false positives. Steps: (1) Go to search.google.com/search-console, add property https://funwithscience.net/dome-model-review/, (2) Choose HTML file verification → download google-siteXXXXXXX.html → commit to docs/, OR choose HTML tag → provide token for build-script meta tag addition, (3) After verification, submit https://funwithscience.net/dome-model-review/sitemap.xml. At 41 days to eclipse this is now the most urgent action — indexing typically takes 1-4 weeks, leaving very little margin.
